title: Panchtikt Ghrit Guggul
description: Panchtikt Ghrit Guggul (Panchatikta Ghrita Guggul Tablet) is a highly potent tablet derived from a classical medicated ghee consisting of five bitter herbs combined with Guggul. This classical formulation deeply purifies the blood through the synergistic action of five bitter herbs known for their blood-cleansing properties. Manages stubborn skin conditions that have resisted ordinary treatment through comprehensive internal cleansing. Advanced osteoarthritis with bone-deep inflammation is addressed through potent anti-inflammatory action. Bone-deep inflammation affecting multiple joint levels is penetrated and resolved. This formulation represents the highest-potency herbal approach to inflammatory conditions.
